svg.title: Directory request mix across observed windows

cc:Work.dc:title: Directory request mix across observed windows
cc:Work.dc:description: Eighty-nine observed flood periods on 64 anonymized relays. Each row has its own total and approximate UTC period and duration. Repeated observations retain the same relay alias and are distinguished by approximate UTC dates and times.
